experiment: NASA SMAP classical RBF One-Class SVM vs QMLib quantum-kernel One-Class SVM

training_protocol.training_data_assumption: Training sequences are assumed to be predominantly normal.

evaluation_protocol.threshold_source: Separate normal calibration scores for each channel and model.
evaluation_protocol.warning: The class-stratified evaluation sample does not preserve the natural anomaly prevalence. Precision, F1 and AP describe this balanced evaluation design and should not be interpreted as deployment metrics at the original SMAP prevalence.

notes: v1-v3 files and results are retained unchanged.
Both methods use identical channel-specific reference, calibration and test observations.
Scaler and PCA are fitted on training data only.
Test labels are used only for evaluation and stratified sampling.
Thresholds are not selected using test labels.
Quantum state cache is cleared after each channel.
No quantum advantage is inferred from these experiments.
